holdout_rule: the three most recently recorded demos of the main set (by file time), fixed before any training
main_note: all pass the recording checks, have a measured grasp point, and grasp the left rim (7-9 o'clock)
natural_grasp_note: grasped the near side (test1, test2: ~6 o'clock) or the right side (~3-5.5 o'clock) of the rim: natural for a right hand, but the robot's infeasible side in this LIBERO scene
excluded_note: hand not tracked at the grasp moment, so no grasp point can be measured
